images.caption: Figure 2:Overview of Chiron. A single language model is jointly trained across three objectives: (1)psychological measurement, where construct scores supervise a measurement head to estimate psychological attributes from personal records; (2)individual behavioural prediction, where answers withheld from a person’s records supervise the prediction of unseen responses and choices; and (3)population simulation, where virtual respondents synthesized to match published human statistics supervise the generation of population-level response distributions.
